race.title: racingtv.com/freetrial Female Jockeys' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: ILLOGICAL LOGIC is certain to benefit from this step back up in trip and David Thompson's gelding can notch a third win for the yard. I See The Sea scored over this trip from a higher mark on the card last year, so is also worth considering, whilst Anytrixwilldo would be of some interest if able to back up his recent Huntingdon success. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR) I SEE THE SEA (IRE) ANYTRIXWILLDO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Anytrixwilldo (11/10), Illogical Logic (5/1), Jo Lescribaa (7/1), I See The Sea (10/1), Aill Dubh (10/1), Unspeakable (12/1), Halfway House Lad (16/1), Hardy Buck (16/1), Balkardy (25/1)
